title: backup: the snapshot registry keeps rows whose snapshots are gone, and nothing flags or prunes them
body:
Found read-only by devbin-dc in Devbin on 2026-11-23, routed by devbin-vc. Nothing was changed there.

`intent backup --list` shows 11 snapshots in Devbin, and only 4 exist on disk. A plain `rm` in a prune script removed eight, and the 08-26 snapshot is missing too, but every one is still a row in Intent's snapshot registry. No verb drops a dead row, and nothing reports one. Doctor's backup-stale advisory cleared once a snapshot was taken at 2026-11-23T03:48:02Z, so a registry of mostly dead rows reads as healthy.

The fix:
- `backup --list` marks a row whose snapshot is gone.
- Doctor reports it, as an advisory, so no attendee repo's verdict changes.
- A verb prunes rows whose snapshots are gone, and prints what it dropped.
